title: Hypervisors & Tier-1 Storage Cascade
steps: Confirm Tier-1 host status via zabbix_host_get and interfaces.
If Tier-1 host is DOWN: declare TOTAL CASCADE first — dependent Tier-2/3 alerts are downstream symptoms.
Phase 1: focus mitigation on Tier-1 before investigating guest VMs.
Check saturation: CPU load > 2*cores, iowait > 20%, available memory < 10%, storage latency.
avoid: Do NOT investigate guest Tier-2/3 VMs individually while the underlying hypervisor is down.
Do NOT claim root cause without load/iowait/memory evidence from the host.
